page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.2xlarge is a burstable virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results highlight a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is limited, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance is more resilient, with stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and software compilation benchmarks achieving average mid-tier results. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle 50% range, though database operations and memory scores fall into the bottom 25%.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation model, this instance is designed for workloads with fluctuating resource demands rather than sustained high-performance computing. It is qualitatively cost-effective for budget-conscious deployments that require a high memory-to-vCPU ratio without continuous CPU utilization. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, development environments, code compilation, and lightweight Redis caching, whereas intensive database operations or heavy single-threaded processing are constrained by the hardware profile.
